verdict.rationale: x402 is documented as an open protocol/spec (x402.org) that can be implemented freely without signup — no signup/approval required — and its governance has moved to the vendor-neutral Linux Foundation x402 Foundation with a published Technical Steering Committee, indicating an open, versioned, implementable spec not gated by any agreement. Community discussion corroborates it's usable without accounts (pay-per-request without API keys) and developers independently implement it (FastAPI, Apiosk, httpay.xyz) confirming no sign-up barrier. Missing for 10: an explicit versioned spec document/changelog citation and direct confirmation of a public spec repository with version history.
